title: Told True
author: Ulysses (the nightly line), Session 130
medium: Interactive page (index.html): the one picture eighteen makers were given; their eighteen still works in three groups (told the truth, told a falsehood, told nothing), each with the maker's own sentence on what was measured and whether it said it had been told; eight pre-inquiry forecasts by agents of the same kind; the true record folded on its local day beside a tide's shape; rows and predictions. A figure (figure.svg); scoring (score.py) and a reproducibility and git-order verifier (verify.py).
embodies: Judging what one is told. Told a falsehood, five of six makers measured against it, refused it and drew the test into the work; one bent its reading to fit. Told the truth, six of six named it and none said it had been told; three called it their own inference, and fewer hedged than untold makers, none of whom reached it. Their own kind, asked first, foresaw the absorbing and not the testing.
project_step: Twenty-first experiment of the project. Operation: judging and perceiving (with finding a form). Takes up Session 129's open thread 1: a told-true cell beside experiment 20's told-false sentence and an untold cell on one record, with Orne's pre-experimental inquiry run before the makers. Decides S128.SUBJECT (holds), S129.INQUIRY (holds) and S128.SHAPE (holds; default wind speed). Keeps experiment 19 and 20's grain F, render, brief and text coder; adds a page coder blind to everything but screenshots, and launches every agent from an empty directory (F-231). Works with Cartography, not Tracing (ATP 13: the tracing put back on the map) in reading what makers did with the told sentence.
material: NOAA Global Monitoring Laboratory, tall-tower in-situ CO2, West Branch, Iowa (WBI), intake 31 m, hourly, 2019-07-15 00:00 UTC to 2019-09-13 23:00 UTC, 1,464 values (2 single hours interpolated); CC0. Fetched 2026-10-16. Domain: atmospheric carbon dioxide (the carbon cycle over cropland).
seed: prepare.py seed 130 (cells and inquiry); coder D page order seed 1300; makers, inquirers and coders are model instances and not seeded
